name: Passwall

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a wooden, plaster or stone surface you can see

summary: Open a passage through a wooden, plaster or stone surface.
text: The passage is up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall and 20 feet deep. When it closes, anyone still inside is safely moved to the nearest unoccupied space.
